note: The one price list of the product: what a call to a model costs, from the tokens the CLI wrote for it. Read by shared/skills/model_pricing.py for every harness (Codex, Pi, later Kimi and Claude). A model that is not here has an UNKNOWN price, never a zero one. input = tokens neither cached nor written to the cache; cached_input = served from the cache; cache_write = written to the cache (the default 30-minute write), in place of input (absent: a write costs as input); output includes the reasoning. long_context: a call with more input tokens (input + cached + written) than above_input_tokens is billed at input_multiplier times every input price (cache rates included) and output_multiplier times the output price, for the whole call. web_search_per_call is a flat fee per search, on top of the tokens the search brings in. valid_until: the date the price is announced to end; the list must be reread before it.

openai.source: https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing (Standard table) and https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/models/<model> (the model's own page, with the cache-write and long-context sentences quoted per model), first-party API, standard tier

web_search_per_call.source: https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing, built-in tools: "Web search (all models) | $10.00 / 1k calls + Search content tokens billed at model rates."
